C0166.title: Global Largest Game Cheat Case Cracked: Amount Involved Reaches Hundreds of Millions of Yuan
C0166.summary: In March 2021, Kunshan police cracked the world largest game cheat case, with illicit flow reaching hundreds of millions of yuan, and dismantled 17 cheat trading and card-distribution platforms across six provinces and nine cities. The cheat, known as Chicken Leg, targeted Peacekeeper Elite and provided auto-aim and wallhack features, severely disrupting game balance. In January 2021, police arrested the global finance head surnamed Wang and other key personnel.
